body:
Indeed, when I run the image locally with:
```
podman run -e JAVA_APP_DIR=/home/jboss <image>
```
it starts to run again.

issue.title: Set JAVA_APP_DIR env var when necessary
issue.body:
When using Jib to build the container image
(and the defaults have not been changed),
`JAVA_APP_DIR` should be present in order to
avoid situations where agent jars cannot
be located.

- Fixes: #39022

body:
Thanks for reporting!

Can you give #39024 a try?

@geoand Thanks for your quick fix!  Not easy for me to directly test your pull req at my end, but I tested that setting the env var really fixes the issue:
```
quarkus.jib.environment-variables.JAVA_APP_DIR=/home/jboss
```
